llm_response.reason: The site mimics a legitimate brand (Caterpillar) but uses a non-official pluralized domain name, was registered very recently, and lists administrative contacts as anonymous with a personal Hotmail email for tech/admin roles. Such traits suggest the site may be posing as an official retailer to trick users into buying non-existent products, a hallmark of fake online shopping scams. These issues match several characteristics of scam websites: company mimicry, ambiguous contact details, suspiciously new domain, and likely non-existent business information.
